text:
Maya: Quick poll — who’s up for a hill sweep at 12:30? 3 laps of Franklin Hill, then 100 squats AMRAP. Loser buys donuts. :doughnut:
Alex: Count me in. Will jog there from office.
Jordan: Tempted... can I swap squats for lunges? My knees are grumpy.
Maya: Jordan, fine, 100 lunges but you still owe donuts if you lose :joy: 
Li: I can only do one lap, got a call at 1. But I’ll do moral support and photos :camera_with_flash: 
Devon: I’ll time everyone. Also bringing resistance bands for warmups.
lunchbot: Signed up: Maya, Alex, Jordan, Li, Devon. Reminder set for 12:15.
Alex: Also a micro-challenge — fastest lap gets a coffee on me.
Jordan: I’ll take the coffee wager. Betting my slow steady pace pays off.
Maya: Ok team — meet outside main atrium at 12:20. Stretch! :muscle:
